english: [H2]Mechanics[\\H2]Each city in your empire has an [BOLD]instability[\\BOLD] ([ICON_INSTABILITY]) value. Each turn, [ICON_INSTABILITY] is increased or decreased by factors such as happiness, distance to capital, religion, nationality, garrison, and others. These factors are listed below in more detail. All factors can be viewed in-game using the Revolution Advisor (%s1).[NEWLINE][PARAGRAPH:0]If [ICON_INSTABILITY] in a city rises over %d2, the city may instigate a revolt, possibly including nearby unstable cities. Revolts come in many different styles, including requests to change civics, requests to change state religion, and demands for independence. No matter what the scenario, you will always be given choices when confronted with a rebellious city. If you repeatedly deny demands and fail to improve stability, a violent revolution will break out.
chinese: [H2]机制[\\H2]你帝国中的每座城市都有一个[BOLD]动荡[\\BOLD]（[ICON_INSTABILITY]）值。每回合，[ICON_INSTABILITY]都会因幸福度、距首都远近、宗教、民族、驻军等诸多因素而升降。这些因素在下文中有更详细的列举。所有因素均可在游戏内通过革命顾问（%s1）查看。[NEWLINE][PARAGRAPH:0]若某座城市的 [ICON_INSTABILITY] 升至 %d2 以上，该城可能挑起一场叛乱，还可能牵连附近不稳定的城市。叛乱形式多样，包括要求更换政策、要求更换国教，以及要求独立。无论何种情形，面对一座反叛的城市时，你总会被给予选择。你若一再拒绝要求且未能改善稳定，一场暴力革命便会爆发。

english: [H2]FfH integration[\\H2]Revolutions are an experimental feature. While fully functional, this game option is only partially integrated into the mod. Instability mechanics have been adjusted to make sense in the world of Erebus, but actual revolts are still relatively generic. I (lfgr) plan to add more diverse revolution styles in the future, such as religion-specific uprisings.
chinese: [H2]FfH 整合[\\H2]革命是一项实验性功能。它虽已完全可用，但这一游戏选项只是部分整合进了本模组。动荡机制已作调整，以契合伊瑞布斯的世界，但实际的叛乱仍相对通用。我（lfgr）计划在未来加入更多样化的革命形式，例如针对特定宗教的起义。

english: [H2]Instability factors[\\H2]Below is the list of effects affecting stability every turn. This page is only inteded to give a rough overview, check the in-game Revolution Advisor (%s1) for more details. Most factors below are capped at some maximum stability or instability. In some cases, the cap can be changed by buildings or civics. There are also many buildings and civics that increase or decrease the effect of certain factors.
chinese: [H2]动荡因素[\\H2]下面列出了每回合影响稳定的各项效应。本页仅意在提供一个粗略概览，更多细节请查看游戏内的革命顾问（%s1）。下列多数因素都有某一稳定或动荡的上限。某些情况下，该上限可由建筑或政策改变。还有许多建筑与政策会增强或削弱特定因素的效应。

english: [BOLD]Happiness/Unhappiness.[\\BOLD] In most cases, the easiest way to keep your cities from revolting is through happiness. On the other hand, excess unhappiness majorly contributes to instability, unless special buildings or civics are used to counter the effect. [NEWLINE]Both effects are much more noticeable for smaller cities, since they're proportional to excess [ICON_HAPPY]/[ICON_UNHAPPY] divided by population size.
chinese: [BOLD]幸福/不满。[\\BOLD]多数情况下，让城市免于反叛最简便的办法便是幸福度。反之，过多的不满会大幅助长动荡，除非动用特殊建筑或政策来抵消这一效应。[NEWLINE]这两种效应对小城市都要显著得多，因为它们与过剩的 [ICON_HAPPY]/[ICON_UNHAPPY] 除以人口规模成正比。

english: [BOLD]Location.[\\BOLD] Each city that is not your capital or a government center (i.e., has %s1) gets a location penalty depending on the distance to the nearest capital (or government center). Size is also a factor; large cities get a larger location penalty. Ways of reducing the location penalty is to connect your cities via roads, rivers, the sea, or teleportation (via %s2).
chinese: [BOLD]区位。[\\BOLD]每一座并非你首都或政府中心（即带有 %s1）的城市，都会依据其与最近首都（或政府中心）的距离而承受一项区位惩罚。规模也是一个因素；大城市承受的区位惩罚更大。减轻区位惩罚的办法，是通过道路、河流、海洋，或（借助 %s2 的）传送将你的城市连通起来。

english: [BOLD]Religion.[\\BOLD] Cities with your state religion get a stability bonus. All other religions cause instability, depending on the level of animosity to your state religion. The worst penalty comes from %s1 vs. %s2. Even if your state religion is neither, they will still cause a small amount of instability.
chinese: [BOLD]宗教。[\\BOLD]信奉你国教的城市会获得一项稳定加成。所有其他宗教都会引发动荡，其程度取决于它对你国教的敌意深浅。最重的惩罚来自 %s1 对 %s2。即便你的国教二者皆非，它们仍会引发少许动荡。

english: [BOLD]Nationality.[\\BOLD] Foreign culture in your cities causes instability. The effect increases quadratically with increasing percentage, so small amounts of foreign culture should not be a problem. Culture from your team members does not count as foreign. Moreover, culture from vassals and other players with your civilization (with whom you're at peace) count partially.
chinese: [BOLD]民族。[\\BOLD]你城市中的外族文化会引发动荡。这一效应随占比升高呈二次方增长，因此少量外族文化应当不成问题。来自你队友的文化不计作外族。此外，来自附庸以及与你同文明（且处于和平状态）的其他玩家的文化，只部分计入。

english: [BOLD]Garrison.[\\BOLD] Stationing troops in a city improves stability. Your citizens take one unit per five population points for granted; you need more units to increase stability (though less units do not cause instability). Some promotions increase your units' stability bonus.
chinese: [BOLD]驻军。[\\BOLD]在城中驻扎部队可改善稳定。你的市民会把每五点人口配一个单位视为理所当然；你需要更多单位方能提升稳定（不过单位偏少并不会引发动荡）。某些晋升可增强你单位的稳定加成。

english: [BOLD]Disorder.[\\BOLD] Disorder causes a lot of instability, especially in cities that haven't revolted yet. Since instability again causes revolts, this can quickly snowball into an uprising. Some units can spread culture (%s1), which also ends revolts - it might be handy to have some of those at the ready.
chinese: [BOLD]混乱。[\\BOLD]混乱会引发大量动荡，尤其是在尚未反叛的城市中。由于动荡又会引发叛乱，这很快便会滚雪球般演成一场起义。某些单位能传播文化（%s1），这同样能平息叛乱——手头备上几个这样的单位或许会很管用。

english: [BOLD]Other effects.[\\BOLD][NEWLINE] [ICON_BULLET]Culture rate provides some stability. The effect grows with the square root of the actual culture rate, so you get diminishing returns when investing a lot in culture.[NEWLINE] [ICON_BULLET]Excess unhealthiness causes a small amount of instability.[NEWLINE] [ICON_BULLET]A golden age provides a big statbility bonus in all cities.[NEWLINE] [ICON_BULLET]If the number of cities is small, you get a small statbility bonus in all cities, whereas a large amount of cities causes a small penalty (the exact meaning of "small" and "large" depends on the map sizue.[NEWLINE] [ICON_BULLET]Various buildings and civics provide a flat stability bonus or instability penalty every turn.
chinese: [BOLD]其他效应。[\\BOLD][NEWLINE] [ICON_BULLET]文化产出率提供一定稳定。此效应随实际文化产出率的平方根增长，因此在文化上投入过多会边际递减。[NEWLINE] [ICON_BULLET]过多的不卫生会引发少许动荡。[NEWLINE] [ICON_BULLET]黄金时代会为所有城市提供一大笔稳定加成。[NEWLINE] [ICON_BULLET]城市数量偏少时，所有城市都会获得少许稳定加成；而城市数量偏多则会带来少许惩罚（“少”与“多”的确切含义取决于地图尺寸）。[NEWLINE] [ICON_BULLET]各类建筑与政策每回合提供固定的稳定加成或动荡惩罚。

english: [H2]Strategy[\\H2]As mentioned, several buildings and civics modify the strength of the above effects. Some civics enable different play styles in this way. For example, [LINK=CIVIC_SACRIFICE_THE_WEAK]Sacrifice the weak[\\LINK] procides a flat instability penalty each turn, and increases the likelihood of revolutions turning violent. On the other hand, the instability penalty from unhappiness is reduced, and the effectiveness of stationing military units in your cities in increased. This is useful e.g. for [LINK=CIVILIZATION_CALABIM]Calabim[\\LINK] players, who rely on excess unhappiness in cities.[NEWLINE][PARAGRAPH:0]Another example is [LINK=CIVIC_ARISTOCRACY]Aristocracy[\\LINK], which has a hefty flat instability penalty (which has to be countered somehow), but decreases instability from distance, and therefore makes large empires more viable.
chinese: [H2]策略[\\H2]如前所述，若干建筑与政策会改变上述效应的强度。某些政策借此开启了不同的玩法风格。举例来说，[LINK=CIVIC_SACRIFICE_THE_WEAK]牺牲弱者[\\LINK]每回合提供一项固定的动荡惩罚，并提高革命转为暴力的概率。另一方面，来自不满的动荡惩罚被减轻，而在城中驻扎军事单位的成效则被提高。这对例如[LINK=CIVILIZATION_CALABIM]卡拉比姆[\\LINK]玩家很有用，他们依赖城市中过剩的不满。[NEWLINE][PARAGRAPH:0]另一个例子是[LINK=CIVIC_ARISTOCRACY]贵族制[\\LINK]，它带有一项沉重的固定动荡惩罚（必须设法加以抵消），但能降低来自距离的动荡，因此让庞大的帝国更为可行。

You get a free promotion for most of your units (the best units in the game, really--melee and gunpowder) and cheap barracks and drydocks to provide additional promotions. War. Duh. Am I not making myself clear, here? Put together a horde and go kill somebody already.[NEWLINE]You'll want your forces to mostly be composed of units that benefit from the trait: Melee units (Warriors, Axemen, Swordsmen, Spearmen, Macemen, Pikemen), Gunpowder units (Musketmen, Riflemen, Grenadiers, Infantry, SAM Infantry, Marines, Mechanized Infantry) and their UU variants.[NEWLINE]Drydocks make Steel a priority technology; likewise with technologies that enable one of the aforementioned units. Note that some of the Aggressive leaders have a UU that benefit from the trait (Montezuma, Alexander, Tokugawa, Ragnar, Shaka) and some do not (Genghis, Kublai, Stalin). The latter do benefit from the cheap barracks, however. Also, remember that you'll need more units than just melee and gunpowder--siege weapons and mounted may not receive Aggressive's free Combat I, but they're still essential.[NEWLINE]The Statue of Zeus world wonder is very good to have--mainly so that someone you're attacking doesn't have it. War weariness is bad enough as it is; having it doubled will definitely put a crimp in your world domination plans.[PARAGRAPH:1][H1]The Downside[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:1]Aggressive in and of itself has no economic advantages and may, in fact, over-encourage you to accrue too many economic liabilities. Every unit has a maintenance cost, remember, and that cost goes up when the unit leaves home turf. In addition, every conquered city has maintenance costs. Over-conquering, especially early in the game, can be just as bad as over-expanding.[NEWLINE]On the plus side, since Aggressive should mean you have better units, hopefully you'll need fewer of them.
