chinese: 山猪骑兵是游戏中最差的骑手。可这不过是个骑猪的矮人，你还指望什么呢？

english: Donal is the hero of the Bannor and a legendary slayer of demons and the undead. He is able to recruit units in cities and, unlike the Great Commander, is not sacrificed by doing so. If Donal proves the legends true, and kills demons and the undead, he will regain the ability to recruit and can build a huge army if he survives his own battles.[PARAGRAPH:2]The hound that tracked him almost looked normal, until it turned and growled. Half of the face was rotted away, and the skull beneath was scratched and chipped, with a dark pit for an eye socket. But it had no trouble seeing its prey. It leapt for Donal's throat.[PARAGRAPH:1]This was far from the first Hellhound Donal had seen. Reflex took over, and he dropped and rolled to avoid the fangs. His crude weapons flew to his hands. Donal and the hound circled each other, feinting and pulling back, until in a flash it was over. Donal dodged the lunge, and sunk his blade into the demon's neck, pinning it to the ground. It growled and thrashed about almost comically, trying to free itself and continue the attack.[PARAGRAPH:1]"C'mon, boy, play dead," Donal said, slamming his shield down upon the hound's skull. Both shattered, and the thrashing stopped. "That's a good dog."[PARAGRAPH:1]He didn't laugh at his jokes any longer. He had stopped amusing himself some time ago. Ten years or a thousand, he had no idea and had stopped caring. Since his people left Hell, there was no one else to laugh either, and yet still he quipped as he grimly fought the inhabitants of this realm. In the home of the King of Despair, his biggest battle was maintaining the one thing that sustained him, hope.[PARAGRAPH:2]"We have no hope, Capria. We must abandon the siege."[PARAGRAPH:1]"Capria turned to face her nephew. "We cannot, Mattius! You heard what I heard from Fanariel's lips. ‘The Sheaim have made a breakthrough. With Agares' guidance.' We must press on!" Capria trembled as she spoke, her aging frame failing her more and more lately. Perhaps she would be steadier if she met her council without full battle armor on, but to be war leader of the Bannor and not be ever battle ready?[PARAGRAPH:1]"Indeed we must," agreed the High Priest. He was young, much younger than the regent he addressed, but he spoke with supreme confidence. "The heresies stemming from Galveholm are provocation enough to mobilize. Sabathiel therefore sees no reason for us to even associate with elven brigands like this Fanariel."[PARAGRAPH:1]Mattius snorted. "I'm sure Sabathiel knows a better way to get a spy into Sheaim lands, but he hasn't been exactly forthcoming lately."[PARAGRAPH:1]"Does the Head of House Venerat doubt the authority of the priesthood to speak for..."[PARAGRAPH:1]"What Mattius was pointing out, Elmin," Capria jumped in, "is that we need to prioritize our missions. The Clans have been building strength, our ambassadors have been expelled from the Lanun capital, and"[PARAGRAPH:1]The war council was interrupted by a tremendous quake, throwing them all to the ground. Capria's reflexes triumphed over the limitations of age; she bounced to her feet and raced out of the tent. The camp was showing the benefits of Bannor discipline and were in formation around the commanders' tent, ready to repel the attack.[PARAGRAPH:1]But it was not an opening magical salvo for an attack. The army watched as the trees and brush on the hillside below them withered and died, the sun was obscured by a dreary haze, and fires erupted on the horizon. It was a scene Capria remembered well from her childhood, and nightmares ever since. 70 years ago they had escaped Hell, and now it had come for them.[PARAGRAPH:2]He had scoured this Hell looking for an escape. Never mind that it was an infinite plane, he swore he'd seen every inch of it twice. He had been chased every step of the way by the minions of Agares and Bhall, and managed to either elude them, or fend them off. All to see this day.[PARAGRAPH:1]Donal saw a portal to the mortal realm stretching out in the valley below him. A rift in dimensions, fluctuating wildly. And around it was arrayed an army of demons. Cavorting Imps, a contingent of Ruhin, a virtual city of manes... and the biggest Balor Donal had seen. And they were leaving. "Oh, not without me, you don't," he muttered as he started down the hillside. "I don't know where you're going, but it's got to be better than here."[PARAGRAPH:1]The demons marched through, as the rift slowly began to close.[PARAGRAPH:2]The demons were on the march. The first battle with them had caused the Bannor army to rout, and since then they had been pushed back to Tor Lehan, the nearest settlement to the corrupted lands. From its battlements Capria could see flames at the border to the Infernal lands all through the night. So far the priests' blessings had kept the corruption at bay, but not the corrupted. They surrounded the settlement, the demons that had haunted her in her youth. Only the most courageous soldiers remained to stand against them.[PARAGRAPH:1]The battle was joined at dawn. It quickly turned against them.[PARAGRAPH:1]Mattius stood alongside his aunt at the battle lines. "If I'm to die, I'm honored to do so beside one of the heroes of legends."[PARAGRAPH:1]Capria nodded, swinging her two-handed sword. "I'd rather live. But if the Bannor do not stand to face this dire threat, who will?" An image at the edge of her field of vision made her turn, coming face to face with a monstrous pit beast.[PARAGRAPH:1]"The trick to these beasties is to get them from behind," shouted an old friend as the Pit Beast was felled. "The wings limit their peripheral vision."[PARAGRAPH:1]"Who... my god, is that you? Donal Lugh?"[PARAGRAPH:1]"In the flesh, for a pleasant change."[PARAGRAPH:1]Mattius gasped. "Then the legends... are all true? We are the Bannor of Sabathiel!"[PARAGRAPH:1]The tide of battle turned. The Bannor lost as many as survived, but the town was saved, and the forces of Hell pushed back for today. The news of the victory spread, shaming those who had fled, and inspiring a new generation. This was the war that Sabathiel had saved them for, and it was only beginning. But the first victory was theirs.
chinese: 卢乌是班诺尔的英雄，一位传奇的恶魔与不死者屠戮者。他能在城市中招募单位，且与大指挥官不同，招募并不会牺牲他自身。倘若卢乌证实传说不虚，斩杀恶魔与不死者，他便会重获招募之能，若能在自己的一场场战斗中幸存下来，还可组建起一支庞大的军队。[PARAGRAPH:2]那头追踪他的猎犬起初几乎看似正常，直到它转过身、发出低吼。半张脸已然腐烂，底下的头骨伤痕累累、缺了几块，一个眼窝是黑黢黢的一洞。可它看猎物却毫无障碍。它朝卢乌的喉咙扑去。[PARAGRAPH:1]这远非卢乌见过的第一头地狱犬。反射本能接管了一切，他俯身翻滚，避开了獠牙。他那简陋的武器飞入手中。卢乌与那猎犬相互绕行，佯攻又退回，直到电光石火间一切告终。卢乌闪过那一扑，把刀刃没入这恶魔的脖颈，将它钉在地上。它低吼着，近乎滑稽地翻腾挣扎，想要脱身、继续攻击。[PARAGRAPH:1]“来吧，乖仔，装死，”卢乌说着，把盾牌狠狠砸在那猎犬的头骨上。二者一齐碎裂，翻腾也停了。“真是条好狗。”[PARAGRAPH:1]他不再为自己的俏皮话发笑了。他早在许久之前就不再自寻乐子。十年还是一千年，他毫无概念，也早已不再在意。自他的族人离开地狱，便再没有别人可以发笑了，可他仍在冷峻地与这一界的居民搏杀时插科打诨。在绝望之王的居所里，他最大的战斗，是维系那唯一支撑着他的东西——希望。[PARAGRAPH:2]“我们没有希望了，凯布瑞尔。我们必须放弃围城。”[PARAGRAPH:1]凯布瑞尔转身面向她的外甥。“我们不能，马提乌斯！你听见我从法纳里尔口中听到的话了。‘塞安人取得了突破。有阿加雷斯的指引。’我们必须挺进！”凯布瑞尔说话时颤抖着，她那衰老的身躯近来愈发不听使唤了。倘若她召见麾下议事时不披全副战甲，或许会稳当些，可身为班诺尔的战争领袖，却不时刻备战？[PARAGRAPH:1]“我们的确必须。”大祭司附和道。他很年轻，比他所奏对的这位摄政年轻得多，说起话来却带着无上的自信。“源自加尔维霍姆的种种异端，已足以构成动员的挑衅。因此萨巴曦尔认为我们连与法纳里尔这样的精灵匪徒结交都毫无理由。”[PARAGRAPH:1]马提乌斯嗤之以鼻。“我敢说萨巴曦尔知道把一名探子送入塞安领地的更好办法，可他近来一直不怎么肯明说。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“维内拉特家的家主莫非在质疑祭司团代言的权威……”[PARAGRAPH:1]“艾敏，马提乌斯要指出的是，”凯布瑞尔插话道，“我们需要为我们的任务排定轻重。余灰部落一直在积蓄力量，我们的使节被逐出了拉努恩首都，还有——”[PARAGRAPH:1]战争议事会被一阵剧烈的地震打断，把众人尽数掀翻在地。凯布瑞尔的反射本能战胜了年迈的局限；她一跃而起，冲出帐篷。营地展现出班诺尔纪律的成效，已在指挥官帐篷四周列好阵形，随时准备击退来袭。[PARAGRAPH:1]可这并非一场攻击开场的魔法齐射。全军眼睁睁看着他们下方山坡上的树木与灌丛枯萎死去，太阳被一层阴沉的霾遮蔽，地平线上火焰迸发。这是凯布瑞尔从孩提时代、并在此后无数噩梦中都记忆犹新的一幕。七十年前他们逃离了地狱，如今地狱却找上门来了。[PARAGRAPH:2]他曾走遍这座地狱，寻找一处出口。且不论它是一片无限的界域，他敢发誓自己每一寸都看过两遍了。他一路上被阿加雷斯与巴尔的爪牙追杀，好歹或是甩脱、或是击退了它们。只为得见今日。[PARAGRAPH:1]卢乌看见下方山谷里延展开一道通往凡间的传送门。一道维度的裂隙，剧烈地波动着。而它周围列布着一支恶魔大军。上蹿下跳的小恶魔、一队鲁宾、一整座恶灵之城……还有卢乌所见过最庞大的巨角炎魔。而它们正在离去。“哦，休想撇下我，你们别想，”他喃喃道，动身下了山坡。“我不知道你们要去哪儿，可那总该好过这里。”[PARAGRAPH:1]恶魔们列队穿过，那裂隙则缓缓开始闭合。[PARAGRAPH:2]恶魔们踏上了征途。与它们的第一战令班诺尔大军溃散，自那以后他们被逼退到了托尔莱汉，那是离受污之地最近的定居点。从它的城垛上，凯布瑞尔整夜都能看见与地狱军团接壤处的火焰。至此，祭司们的祝福挡住了污秽，却挡不住那些受污者。它们围住了定居点，那些曾在她年少时缠扰她的恶魔。唯有最勇敢的士兵留下来与它们对峙。[PARAGRAPH:1]战斗在破晓时打响。它很快便对他们不利起来。[PARAGRAPH:1]马提乌斯与他的姨母并肩立于战线上。“我若注定要死，能死在传说中的英雄之一身旁，我倍感荣幸。”[PARAGRAPH:1]凯布瑞尔点点头，挥舞着她的双手巨剑。“我倒宁愿活着。可倘若班诺尔人不挺身面对这可怖的威胁，还有谁会呢？”视野边缘的一个身影令她转过身，与一头狰狞的嗜血兽撞了个正着。[PARAGRAPH:1]“对付这些畜生的诀窍是从背后下手，”一位老友高喊着，那嗜血兽应声倒地。“翅膀限制了它们的余光视野。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“是谁……我的天，是你吗？神子卢乌？”[PARAGRAPH:1]“如假包换，难得地以血肉之躯现身。”[PARAGRAPH:1]马提乌斯倒抽一口气。“那么那些传说……全是真的？我们是萨巴曦尔的班诺尔人！”[PARAGRAPH:1]战局逆转了。班诺尔人阵亡的与幸存的一样多，可城镇得救了，地狱的军队今日被击退了。捷报传开，令那些逃走的人蒙羞，也激励了新的一代。这正是萨巴曦尔一直保全他们以待的那场战争，而它才刚刚开始。可第一场胜利，属于他们。

english: For here, apart, dwells one whose hands have wrought[NEWLINE]Strange eidola that chill the world with fear;[NEWLINE]Whose graven runes in tomes of dread have taught[NEWLINE]What things beyond the star-gulfs lurk and leer.[NEWLINE]Dark Lord of Averoigne-whose windows stare[NEWLINE]On pits of dream no other gaze could bear![NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Eidolon serve no master but willingly enlist in any deadly conflict. Good religions shun these demonic creatures, or seek them out for destruction, but those who tolerate their vile presence find them to be fearless, deadly warriors, nearly unmatched on any battlefield.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Only evil players can build Eidolon's.
chinese: 因这里，孤然独处，居着一位——其手曾造出[NEWLINE]令世间因惧而战栗的怪异幻影；[NEWLINE]其镌于恐怖典籍中的符文曾昭示[NEWLINE]星渊之外潜伏窥伺的种种存在。[NEWLINE]阿维洛涅的暗黑之主——其窗棂凝望着[NEWLINE]无人目光所能承受的梦之深坑！[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]幻影死灵不侍奉任何主人，却甘愿投身任何殊死的争斗。良善的宗教避这些恶魔造物唯恐不及，或索性搜寻并将其铲除，可那些容忍其邪恶存在的人，会发觉它们是无所畏惧、致命的战士，在任何战场上都几乎无可匹敌。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]唯有邪恶阵营的玩家才能建造幻影死灵。

english: The Ljosalfar hero is one of the earliest, allowing the elves to go on the offensive before city defense of their opponents forces them to bring along arcane units. If built after the Ljosalfar archery range, he should benefit from the +1 bonus attack strength it supplies to archers.
